Integrity rules

The main things you can't do

  • Leave the quiz. Switching tabs, windows or apps counts.
  • Exit full screen or resize the window once you've started.
  • Copy, paste, right-click or take screenshots.
  • Move your mouse off the page for more than a moment.
  • Open developer tools or other ways of peeking at the page.

These are the main ones, not a full list. Each violation costs 30 seconds; a second one ends the quiz as a fail.
